sections.usage:
```
Analyze a dataset of telecom customer data to identify patterns and factors contributing to customer churn. The dataset includes columns like [CUSTOMER_ID], [MONTHS_AS_CUSTOMER], [TOTAL_CHARGES], [CONTRACT_TYPE], [PAYMENT_METHOD], and [CHURN_STATUS]. Provide a Python script that processes this data and generates insights.
```
Copy

```
```python
# Telecom Churn Analysis Script

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
churn_data = pd.read_csv('telecom_churn.csv')

# Data Preprocessing
churn_data['TotalCharges'] = pd.to_numeric(churn_data['TotalCharges'], errors='coerce')
churn_data.dropna(inplace=True)

# Analyze churn rate by contract type
churn_by_contract = churn_data.groupby(['Contract', 'Churn']).size().unstack().plot(kind='bar', stacked=True)
plt.title('Churn Rate by Contract Type')
plt.xlabel('Contract Type')
plt.ylabel('Number of Customers')
plt.show()

# Analyze churn rate by payment method
churn_by_payment = churn_data.groupby(['PaymentMethod', 'Churn']).size().unstack().plot(kind='bar', stacked=True)
plt.title('Churn Rate by Payment Method')
plt.xlabel('Payment Method')
plt.ylabel('Number of Customers')
plt.show()

# Identify key factors contributing to churn
print("Key Factors Contributing to Churn:")
print(churn_data.groupby('Churn').mean())
```
